Facts: Two parts.

(A) 常2某, a deputy director of Hunan Provincial Science and Technology Department Development Plan Division, used his position to accept bribes from companies for helping them get national innovation fund projects. He received cash 27.9417万 from Wang, Chen, Li etc. That's classic "受贿" (bribery) for a public official. Also "单位受贿"? The charge list includes "受贿" and "单位受贿". "单位受贿" is for a unit (organization) receiving bribes. Here the individual (常2某) is a public official receiving bribes. So "受贿". Also there is "滥用职权"? He also abused his authority to facilitate false project approvals and allowed misuse of funds. That could be "滥用职权". The list includes "滥用职权". The second part: He colluded with the director of innovation fund management center to fake applications and get 150万 of provincial funds, with 104万 taken by the other. This is abuse of power and possibly "贪污"? But he is a public official, not a unit. He facilitated false project approvals and allowed misappropriation of public funds. That could be "滥用职权" (abuse of power) and maybe "受贿" (since he got bribes). Also "贪污" is for public officials who misappropriate public funds they have custody of. He didn't directly take the 150万, but he helped to get it and maybe got some? The text says 104万 was taken by 聂某甲. It doesn't say 常2某 got that money. He got bribes separately. So the main crimes: "受贿" and "滥用职权". Also possibly "贪污" if he misappropriated funds, but not indicated. The second part is about false project approvals and misappropriation of funds, which is a form of "滥用职权" (abuse of power). The list includes "滥用职权". So answer: 受贿;滥用职权.

Check if "单位受贿" applies: The defendant is an individual, not a unit. So not.

Thus final answer: [罪名]受贿;滥用职权<eoa>
